rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for a tune or phrase that sticks in your head, especially an earworm.

example.english: This song is really catchy; it keeps playing in my head.
example.traditional: 呢首歌真係好洗腦，我個腦成日播住。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 zan1 hai6 hou2 sai2 nou5 ngo5 go3 nou5 seng4 jat6 bo3 zyu6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that a tune, lyric, or phrase is easy to sing, say, and remember.

example.english: That slogan is quite catchy—you remember it after seeing it once.
example.traditional: 呢句廣告口號幾上口，睇一次就記得。
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 gwong2 gou3 hau2 hou6 gei2 soeng5 hau2 tai2 jat1 ci3 zau6 gei3 dak1
